findings.title: Trumbull County will have no hospital labor and delivery unit after St. Joseph move
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Labor and delivery will move out of St. Joseph by early December and will be replaced by a 25-bed inpatient unit.
findings.access_consequences: Mercy Health plans to end deliveries at St. Joseph Hospital by early December 2026 and direct them to St. Elizabeth Boardman Hospital in Youngstown. Ideastream reports Trumbull County would have no hospital labor-and-delivery unit. A nurses' association representative cited roughly 27 miles between hospitals; exact patient travel impact requires review.
findings.affected_population: Pregnant patients and families seeking hospital-based labor and delivery in Trumbull County, including rural residents; exact affected count unverified.
findings.timing_qualification: Newly surfaced high-value recall candidate, not newly published within this hourly window: the source explicitly timestamps November 4, 2026 at 1:05 p.m. EST (10:05 a.m. PST). Not found in the enumerated November 4 supplementary Care Line ledger files; production deduplication not verified.
